clue.text: Snapshot capturing final manmade material

clue.text: Being moral is remarkably un-piratical

explanation.walkthrough: The made-up word un-piratical is the fodder, its eleven letters rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A puritanical person holds strict ethical standards, so the word describes being severely principled.

clue.text: Lexicon in this way accommodating a user that's confused

clue.text: Pull up after intervention of University security officer
